mapper.select:
select tu.id, tu.avatar, tu.nick_name, tu.birth_date, tu.height, tu.education, us.read_status,tu.edu_auth, tu.lately_time, tu.create_time, tu.city, tu.id_auth,
(select count(1) from user_star ust where ust.del_flag=0 and ust.user_id=#{ownerId} and ust.star_user_id=tu.id)>0 as isFriend,
tu.sex
,CASE WHEN tu.lon IS NOT NULL AND tu.lat IS NOT NULL THEN ST_Distance_Sphere( POINT(#{lon}, #{lat}), POINT(tu.lon, tu.lat) ) ELSE NULL END AS distance
,us.id as starId from user_star us left join t_user tu on us.user_id = tu.id
us.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag = 0
and us.star_user_id=#{ownerId}
order by us.create_time desc,us.id desc

select tu.id, tu.avatar, tu.nick_name, tu.birth_date, tu.height, tu.education,tu.edu_auth, (select ua.`status` from user_apply ua where ua.del_flag=0 and ua.user_id=#{ownerId} and ua.apply_user_id=us.star_user_id limit 1) as applyStatus, tu.lately_time, tu.create_time, tu.city, tu.id_auth,
(select count(1) from user_star ust where ust.del_flag=0 and ust.user_id=tu.id and ust.star_user_id=#{ownerId})>0 as isFriend,
tu.sex
,CASE WHEN tu.lon IS NOT NULL AND tu.lat IS NOT NULL THEN ST_Distance_Sphere( POINT(#{lon}, #{lat}), POINT(tu.lon, tu.lat) ) ELSE NULL END AS distance
from user_star us left join t_user tu on us.star_user_id = tu.id
us.del_flag = 0 and tu.del_flag = 0
and us.user_id=#{ownerId}
order by us.create_time desc
select count(1) from user_star us left join t_user tu on us.user_id=tu.id where us.del_flag=0 and tu.del_flag=0 and tu.id is not null and us.read_status='0' and us.star_user_id=#{id}
